meta.title: A Box Robot for Our Class

paragraphs: Hello! I am Lily. Our class has a box robot. It is in our classroom. It is gray and very big. You can make a robot too. Get a big box and a small box. Get paper and a pen too. Ask Mom or Dad to make it with you.

One, close the big box. Two, put the small box on it. That is the head. Three, draw two eyes on the head. Four, draw a mouth. Five, make two arms with paper. Six, put the arms on the big box. Seven, draw a door on the robot. Look at your robot! It has two eyes and a mouth.

Now your robot wants a friend. It can hold a teddy. Put a teddy in its arms. Teacher Kim asks, "What is its name?" Leo says, "Bill!" "Hello, Bill," says the class. Bill sits next to the board. He is our new friend. The class likes him a lot. We love Bill!
text.summary: Lily shows how her class makes a robot from two boxes. The robot has two paper arms and holds a teddy.
